notes: *found none*: the negation is realized in *none* and given to οὐχ, leaving *found* to εὗρεν. Reading *none* as a supplied object folded onto the verb would empty a negator English realizes.
συκῆν → *a fig tree* headed on *tree* as the core of the English rendering, on the model of ζῷον → *living creature*; a head on *fig* remains defensible.
τις → *A certain man* headed on *certain*, *man* being the generic completion (rules 17, 69).
